description: This file contains functions related to Android Gateway diagnostics, including generating diagnostic reports, checking gateway status, and copying reports to the clipboard.

methods.name: openClawAndroidVersionLabel
methods.description: Returns a label for the Android version, appending "-dev" if in debug mode and version name is not empty, or 'dev'.

methods.name: gatewayStatusForDisplay
methods.description: Converts the status text to a trimmed string, returning "Offline" if empty.

methods.name: gatewayStatusHasDiagnostics
methods.description: Checks if the gateway status indicates diagnostics are available, excluding 'offline' and 'connecting' statuses.

methods.name: gatewayStatusLooksLikePairing
methods.description: Determines if the status text suggests pairing or approval processes.

methods.name: buildGatewayDiagnosticsReport
methods.description: Generates a detailed diagnostic report string for troubleshooting gateway connection issues.

methods.name: copyGatewayDiagnosticsReport
methods.description: Copies the diagnostics report to the clipboard and shows a toast notification.
